**Given below are four jumbled sentences. Select the option that gives their correct order.**

**A. **“It is mine. I saw it first," claimed one cat.

**B.** Suddenly they spotted a loaf of bread lying beneath a tree.

**C. **Once upon a time, two cats were passing through a street.

**D.** Both pounced upon it and caught the loaf at the same time.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is CBDA.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• While arranging the parts of the passage, we should find some grammatical or contextual connections between them:
 
 
• Sentence C introduces us to the subject 'two cats'. It is the introductory sentence and will be put in the first place.
 
• Sentence B tells us about the instance of the cats spotting a loaf of bread. It will be put in second place.
 
• Sentence D tells us the reaction of the cats after seeing the loaf of bread. It will be put in third place.
 
• The last sentence is A as it mentions the conviction of one of the cats that the loaf was hers as she first spotted it.

 
 
 

Thus, the correct order is - *Once upon a time, two cats were passing through a street. Suddenly they spotted a loaf of bread lying beneath a tree. Both pounced upon it and caught the loaf at the same time. “It is mine. I saw it first," claimed one cat.*

The correct answer is __**PMVVY.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **__Important Points__**

__
 
• In **May 2017,** the Government of India introduced a pension scheme for senior citizens i.e. **Pradhan Mantri Vaya Vandan Yojana** and implemented through **Life Corporation of India**.
 
• In this scheme, a guaranteed return of **8%** per annum, payable monthly is assured on payment of minimum Rs. **1.5 lakh** initially for Rs. **1000 per month** pension to a maximum of Rs. **7.5 lakh** initially for Rs. **5000 **per month pension.

**PMGAY: Pradhan Mantri Gramin Aawas Yojana**

__
 
• It aims to provide houses to people living in rural India.
 
• It was previously known as Indira Aawas Yojana launched in 1985 by the then Prime Minister of India Rajiv Gandhi.
 
• This Yojana now aims to provide houses to all by 2022.

**PMGSY: Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana**

 
• Launched to provide road connectivity to the unconnected part of the country to eradicate poverty.
 
• Under this yojana, 3.71 lakh km road will be constructed to connect 1.67 lakh unconnected habitations and 3.68 lakh km roads will be upgraded.

**PMMVY: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana**

 
• Introduced in 2017 by Ministry of Women and Child Development which involves financial aid to pregnant and lactating women having age of 19 years or above as women generally suffer wage loss during the time of childbirth and childcare.

• No medical certificate is required to opt for this scheme.

questions.question: 'Nibble' in computer terminology is also called ______.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Half Byte.**__

__
 
• **Nibble** is also known as half-byte or tetrade and has sixteen possible values represented by a hex digit.
 
• It is used to state the memory consumption to store a digit in packed decimal format within an IBM mainframe to enhance the computation and the process of debugging.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

**Unit Conversion Table:**

__
 
• 4 bit = 1 Nibble
 
• 8 bit = 1 byte
 
• 1 KB (kilobyte) = 1024 byte
 
• 1 MB (megabyte) = 1024 KB
 
• 1 GB (gigabyte) = 1024 MB
 
• 1 TB (terabyte) = 1024 GB
 
• 1 PB (petabyte) = 1024 TB
 
• 1 XB (Exabyte) = 1024 PB
 
• 1 ZB (zettabyte) = 1024 XB
 
• 1 YB (yottabyte) = 1024 ZB

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• Decimal value of 10 in 8-bit byte system = 00001010 = 0 × 2⁰ + 1 × 2¹ + 0 × 2² + 1 × 2³ + 0 × 2⁴ + 0 × 2⁵ + 0 × 2⁶ + 0 × 2⁷ = 2 + 8 = 10
 
• Decimal value of 10 in 4-bit nibble system = 1010

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e085a7f17645c801966c030eb44d69fae944b96fdb4c4077f5fba1bc2c24bc71.png] **Mistake Points__**

 
• In data communication, Nibble is known as **Quadbits.**
 
• The smallest unit of information which can be stored is called as **Bit**.
 
• A single bit can only hold 1 or 0.

questions.question: Flagella are the hair-like structures which act as organelles of locomotion in which of the following organisms?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is__** Bacteria.**__

__
 
• Flagella have a filamentous structure that helps in the locomotion of **Archea, Bacteria, and Eukaryotes**.
 
• Flagellum means ‘**whip**’ and this whip-like structure enables a cell to propel in liquid.
 
• Some flagella act as sensory organs in few organisms that sense changes in pH and temperature.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

Flagella are composed of **flagellin** protein which makes its helical structure. **Its structure is divided into three parts **–

 
• **Basal Body**: attached to the cell membrane and cytoplasmic membrane and consists of rings surrounded by MotB protein.
 
• **Hook**: connects motor protein in the base to the filament.
 
• **Filament**: thin hair-like structure arising from the Hook.

**Functions of Flagella:**

 
• Helps in locomotion
 
• Act as sensory organs (sense pH and temperature)
 
• Increase reproduction rates in few eukaryotes
 
• Used as a Secretary organelle in **Chlamydomonas**

**Types of Flagella:**

 
• **Monotrichous**: Single flagellum at one pole
 
• **Amphitrichous:** Single flagellum at each pole
 
• **Lophotrichous**: 2 or more flagellum at one or both poles

 4. **Peritrichous**: Flagellum all over the surface

**Structure of Flagella**

questions.question: ______ is the tube that carries urine from the kidney to the urinary bladder.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Ureter.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In humans, the kidney is one of the main organs of the excretory system.
 
• The kidney's function is the filtration of the blood and removing waste(toxic) products.
 
• Waste products and excess fluid are removed through the urine.
 
• If the kidney fails person needs to undergo dialysis.
 
• Dialysis is a treatment that filters and purifies the blood using a machine
 
• The human excretory system includes certain organs that eliminate the wastes such as salts, carbon dioxide, urea, uric acid and water produced by the body.
 
• The path of the urine in the human excretory system is -
 
• After filtering from the kidney → The urine through Ureter → Stored in the Urinary bladder → Exits through the urethra.

questions.question: Laterite soil is rich in:
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Iron Oxide.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Laterite is a Latin word that means "**Later"**.
 
• **Francis Hamilton** (a Scottish Physician) first described and named a laterite formation in** Southern India** in **1807.**
 
• Laterite is both soil and a rock type and rich in **Iron & Aluminium**.
 
• Nearly all laterites are of rusty-red coloration, because of high** iron oxide** content.
 
• They evolve by intense and sustained weathering of the underlying parent rock.
 
• Laterite soils have a high content of clay, which ensures that they have a greater ability to exchange cations and retain water than sandy soils, and can thus be used as a hard material like a brick.
 
• It is formed in hot & wet tropical areas & majorly found between the **Tropics of Cancer and Capricorn.**
 
• **Angkor wat **in **Cambodia **is an example for use of laterite soil as a construction material. 

**Example of construction with Laterite in Angkor, Cambodia**
